trials.claim: Tool automates new group members onboarding for Facebook group owners
trials.claimQuote: A must-have tool for every Facebook group owner to automate new group members onboarding
trials.reasoning: The vendor and a buyer both describe approval automatically capturing emails, syncing data, and welcoming members without manual work. The Chrome-open limit and one buyer's broader daily-work comment do not negate that onboarding automation.

exhibits.quote: Approve members who meet your criteria and decline the rest, automatically, 24/7 while Chrome is open.
exhibits.argument: Automation only works while Chrome is open, so it is not fully hands-free onboarding.

exhibits.quote: this extension helps me to automate only barely 20% of my daily work
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the tool automates only a small fraction of daily moderation work.

exhibits.quote: Group Collector captures every email first, syncs it to Google Sheets and your marketing tools, and welcomes new members. Automatically.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the tool automatically captures emails, syncs data, and welcomes new members upon approval.

exhibits.quote: I feel great every time I click the approve button or someone gets preapproved and I know a bunch of other things get done without me lifting a finger.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms approval triggers other tasks automatically without manual effort.

trials.claim: Saves Facebook Group members' data to Google Sheet
trials.claimQuote: Save Facebook Group members' data to Google Sheet
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report the Google Sheet data is jumbled and emails are not extracted into a clean column. That materially undercuts reliable saving of member data to Google Sheets, outweighing the single positive review.

exhibits.quote: The information on both the dashboard and connected Google Sheets is jumbled up
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Sheet data is jumbled, undermining reliable saving to Google Sheet.

exhibits.quote: the emails are not even extracted in a clean column in the google sheet
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports emails are not saved cleanly in the Sheet as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Every member's name, email, answers, and profile data automatically flows into your Google Sheet the moment you approve them.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states member data automatically flows to Google Sheet on approval.

exhibits.quote: Fills all of my members data to the Google Sheet and Autoresponders.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool fills member data to Google Sheet.

trials.claim: Integrates with autoresponders without using Zapier
trials.claimQuote: Integrate Facebook Group Collector with autoresponders without using Zapier
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the autoresponder integration should not be advertised as working and that a Zapier zap via Google Sheets was used to reach an autoresponder. That conflicts with the promise of direct integration without Zapier, outweighing the single ConvertKit confirmation.

exhibits.quote: shouldn't be advertised as being able to work with autoresponder/email intregrations
exhibits.argument: Buyer says autoresponder integration does not work as advertised due to jumbled data.

exhibits.quote: (With a Google Sheets to my autoresponder Zap in Zapier 😉)
exhibits.argument: Long-term user still needed Zapier to get emails into autoresponder, contradicting no-Zapier claim.

exhibits.quote: When you approve a member, their email and data syncs directly. No Zapier, no middleware, no extra monthly bill.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states email syncs directly to email platforms with no Zapier needed.

exhibits.quote: It automatically adds my new group members to Convertkit.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms automatic sync of new members to autoresponder Convertkit.
